# Deploy DeepTutor - personalized AI tutoring on Railway

Deploy DeepTutor for personalized, source-grounded AI tutoring.

[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/deeptutor-personalized-ai-tutoring)

## About

DeepTutor is an open-source, lifelong personalized tutoring system. Deploy the official DeepTutor container on Railway with persistent storage, protected administrator access, and an OpenAI model configuration.

This template runs the official `ghcr.io/hkuds/deeptutor:latest` image as one Railway service. A volume mounted at `/app/data` preserves DeepTutor settings and tutoring data across restarts. The service enables secure administrator authentication and exposes the web application through Railway's generated public domain.

## What gets deployed

| Service | Source | Type |
|---------|--------|------|
| DeepTutor | `ghcr.io/hkuds/deeptutor:latest` | Web service |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `PORT` | 3782 | Internal DeepTutor web port. Keep the preconfigured value 3782. |
| `OPENAI_MODEL` | - | OpenAI chat model available to the supplied API key. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | (secret) | OpenAI API key used for DeepTutor's AI tutoring workflows. |
| `DEEPTUTOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | (secret) | Strong password for the DeepTutor admin account, at least 12 characters. |

## Configuration

- **Start command:** `/bin/sh -c "printf %s  | base64 -d | python && export BACKEND_HOST=127.0.0.1 && exec /app/entrypoint.sh"`
- **Healthcheck:** `/login`
- **Networking:** Public domain with automatic HTTPS
- **Volume:** `/app/data`

**Category:** AI/ML
